# Stakeholder map

Who matters for the website relaunch and how they like to be informed. The marketing director decides on the visual identity and wants a weekly summary. The head of sales cares about the product pages and the forms. Legal reviews the cookie banner and the privacy text. The editors are the daily users of the new platform and should test it early.

I place each person on a grid of influence and interest. Those with high influence and high interest get a conversation; the others get an email. Update the map after every steering meeting.

See [[Website relaunch]] and [[Relaunch kickoff]].
